title: About CodeUp
intro: CodeUp is a platform that helps you find yourself in the world of programming through interactive courses, an advanced development environment, a community of like-minded and experienced developers. CodeUp was developed by Ben Siebert for Jugend forscht 2023. In May 2024, the project was reopened and will presumably also participate in Jugend forscht 2025.
